name: Stage 31:1: Halsbråten, etapp 31 to Skjutgropen, etapp 32
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 31:1, Halsbråten, etapp 31 to Skjutgropen, etapp 32.
utilities: Official area: Norrköpings kommun, Nyköpings kommun, Stavsjö.
Official distance is 8.5 km from Halsbråten/stage 31 to Skjutgropen/stage 32; Naturkartan gives 8613 m and the OSM relation geometry is about 8.6 km, while the OSM tag itself rounds to 8 km.

Naturkartan site 73447 draws a 222-point line of about 8.59 km from near Halsbråten to near Stage 32; topologically stitched OSM relation 9631248 is about 8.60 km from the exact Stage 31 shared node to the exact Stage 32 shared node.
This is a connector/extraslinga, not part of the main linear Sörmlandsleden route. Keep the main sequence as Stage 31 to Stavsjö to Stage 32, and expose 31:1 as an optional branch/loop component.

Character is forest paths and minor roads with some wet/marsh sections, E4 noise/underpass context, Gullvagnen lake, Götas grav/Koleragrav, Jättegryta, Långa Längan, Krokeks ödekyrka/Vårfruklostret, Hagsätter spring and Tranmossen.
There is no confirmed official shelter or toilet on 31:1 itself. Nearby shelter/toilet options belong to adjacent stages: Björnsjön on stage 31 and Lövsjön on stage 32.

Practical access and services are best handled via Stavsjö rather than the branch endpoints; Stavsjö has bus, parking, food/service and lodging contexts from adjacent stages, while Krokeks ödekyrka and the Gullvagnen/E4 area offer local parking context only.

The Krokeks ödekyrka/Långa Längan/Götas grav area is in Norrköpings kommun/Östergötland, while the northern Stavsjö-Halsbråten side is tied to Nyköping/Södermanland. Fire, dog and public-place rules can therefore differ along the connector.
waterSources: Hagsätter spring after Krokeks ödekyrka at 58.707017, 16.379233 is the only official water source on 31:1; OSM maps a spring within a few meters.
Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee source flow or water quality and does not test water. Treat/filter/boil the spring water and carry backup.

Gullvagnen is a small natural bathing lake/swim opportunity, not a potable water source or monitored municipal bathing place. For monitored bathing-water context nearby, use off-route Stavsjöbadet rather than Gullvagnen.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official 31:1 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. The adjacent stage-31 Åboravinen reroute/windfall warning matters only when approaching via stage 31 or walking Stavsjörundan.

The Skjutgropen name is slightly ambiguous: the practical 31:1/stage-32 junction is around 58.710121, 16.418001, while the OSM named locality Skjutgropen is east of the route around 58.709696, 16.426384. Do not snap the route endpoint to the locality marker.
The branch crosses/overlaps local Östgötaleden context. OSM currently shares Stage 31:1 ways with Östgötaleden relations; treat that as overlap metadata, not new Sörmlandsleden geometry.

Do not duplicate Stavsjörundan over Stage 31:1: the loop reuses existing Stage 31, Stage 31:1 and Stage 32 pieces. Skiren runt belongs to Stage 32/Skiren and should not be followed as Stage 31:1 continuation.
Långa Längan is a rest/fireplace/heritage point. Historical/local text mentions overnight use, but it is not verified as current bookable lodging or an official shelter.

Use Långa Längan's established fireplace only when current fire bans/brandrisk allow. Check both Norrköping/Östergötland and Nyköping/Södermanland channels where relevant; during tightened fire bans even fixed fireplaces can be closed.

Krokeks ödekyrka/Vårfruklostret is protected cultural heritage and cemetery context. Stay on paths, do not climb on ruins or walls, do not move stones, dig, build fire rings, metal-detect, disturb graves, or pitch tents on ruin/cemetery ground.
No official tent site is listed on 31:1. Use allemansrätten carefully, avoid cultural remains and sensitive/grazed land around Krokeks ödekyrka/Långa Längan, and follow any local signs.
Dogs need extra supervision from March 1 to August 20 and are safest leashed near cultural sites, roads, bathing places, cemetery ground and possible grazing land.

Community reports broadly support good route character and clear marking, but mention vegetation-obscured or messy sections and wet low terrain around mosses. Keep an offline map and stay on boardwalk/plank crossings around Tranmossen.
Stavsjörundan text warns that motorway-adjacent gravel-road sections may need future relocation because of Ostlänken; keep GPX/official maps fresh.

facilities.name: Halsbråten / stage 31 junction
facilities.description: Official 31:1 start coordinate and junction with stage 31. Not a standalone serviced trailhead; no verified parking, toilet, water or transit at the junction.

facilities.name: Östgötaleden / Sörmlandsleden split
facilities.description: Approximate early route-choice area about 0.9 km from Halsbråten. Official text says Östgötaleden turns right/east while Sörmlandsleden continues left/south; follow orange/local signs because direction wording varies by walking direction.

facilities.name: Gullvagnen swim/rest
facilities.description: Small natural bathing lake named by official text; the route passes nearby rather than through the lake center. No official monitored bathing-water page was verified, and this is not a potable-water source.

facilities.name: Gullvagnen / E4 underpass parking
facilities.description: Local/OSM parking context near Gullvagnen and the E4-underpass side of Stavsjörundan. Useful for access planning, but not a Sörmlandsleden-endorsed stage trailhead; local reports still describe parking along this connector as ad hoc.

facilities.name: E4 underpass context
facilities.description: Motorway-adjacent underpass/road section. Expect traffic noise and keep to the signed route; official Stavsjörundan text notes this corridor may be affected by future Ostlänken relocation pressure.

facilities.name: Götas grav / Koleragrav
facilities.description: Old cholera burial/cultural site mentioned by official/local material. Treat as protected/sensitive heritage context: stay respectful, do not disturb markers/ground, and avoid camping on or near the remains.

facilities.name: Jättegryta / picnic area
facilities.description: Official route highlight before Långa Längan. OSM verifies a nearby picnic node, but the exact giant's-kettle coordinate is not separately verified; treat this as approximate route-highlight context.

facilities.name: Långa Längan / former guesthouse
facilities.description: Restored remnant of Krokeks gästgivargård. Heritage/local text mentions past overnight use, but this is not verified as current lodging, an official shelter, or a bookable hut.

facilities.name: Långa Längan fireplace/rest area
facilities.description: Official/rest-area fireplace, with OSM picnic/fireplace data and Stavsjörundan noting fireplace under roof. Use only when current fire rules allow; during tightened fire bans even fixed fireplaces may be closed.

facilities.name: Krokeks ödekyrka / Vårfruklostret
facilities.description: Church/monastery ruin and cemetery cultural site, also linked to Klosterleden. Protected heritage/cemetery context: stay on paths, do not climb on ruins/walls, move stones, dig, build fire rings, metal-detect, disturb graves or camp on the ruin/cemetery ground.

facilities.name: Krokeks ödekyrka parking
facilities.description: Parking near the ruin is mapped in OSM and mentioned by local/loop sources. Useful mid-route access, but check local signs and do not block access.

facilities.name: Hagsätter spring
facilities.description: Official spring after Krokeks ödekyrka, matched by OSM spring data. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Skinnarbovägen bus access
facilities.description: Nearby bus-stop context west of Götas grav/Koleragrav, mapped in OSM/Sörmlandstrafiken cache. Useful for bailouts/access, but check live line 564/other service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Tranmossen wetland/boardwalk context
facilities.description: Wetland/marsh area passed toward Skjutgropen; blogs/loop notes mention boardwalk/spång and wet terrain, with older reports calling the boardwalk solid and newer mixed reports mentioning messy/overgrown sections. Stay on marked route/boards and expect wet footing.

facilities.name: Skjutgropen stage 32 junction
facilities.description: Practical 31:1 endpoint and connection to stage 32 inferred from route geometry. This is west of the named Skjutgropen locality.

facilities.name: Skjutgropen locality caveat
facilities.description: Named locality east of the trail junction. Useful place-name context, but not the exact connector endpoint.

facilities.name: Stavsjö access for Stavsjörundan
facilities.description: Practical access anchor for using 31:1 as part of Stavsjörundan. Bus/parking/lodging/services are in Stavsjö, not at the branch endpoints.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Krog & Kafé services
facilities.description: Nearby service anchor for loop planning, with food/cafe/shop context and generally daily 08:00-20:00 hours as checked. Verify current opening before relying on it.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Kolmården Vandrarhem / Apartments
facilities.description: Nearby lodging context for loop planning at Störningsväg 8. Verify current booking/check-in before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kolmårdens station wider access
facilities.description: Wider public-transport context south of Krokeks ödekyrka, served by Östgötatrafiken lines such as 420/421/902. It is several kilometres off 31:1, so treat as area access rather than a trailhead stop.

facilities.name: Åboravinen approach caveat
facilities.description: Not on 31:1 itself, but relevant if approaching from Åbo/stage 31 or walking Stavsjörundan: current official road-detour/windfall warning in Åboravinen.
